run_training_job: run a training job by executing python -m lcm.train with a hydra recipe config
run_dry_run: run a dry run of the trainer to validate config without starting actual training
run_debug_training: run training in debug mode by setting launcher.cluster to debug
review_trainmodule_class: review the TrainModule class that extends StopesModule to schedule and run training jobs
review_run_async: review the async run function that dumps config, instantiates launcher, and schedules training
